ysqf4wx5.baseName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
ysqf4wx5.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
ysqf4wx5.sourceDescription: With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this 10ft pre-lit Christmas tree. The Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations. Our customers love how full and bushy the Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 10ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps) and the ready-lit branches. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 10ft • 1000 professionally hand strung multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 5734 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 200cm diameter • Foliage colour: Dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

qpbze76d.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Celestara Fibre Optic Tree - Warm White
qpbze76d.sourceDescription: The 7ft Celestara Fibre Optic Christmas Tree features green artificial foliage with 270 branch tips and an overall diameter of approximately 95cm. Integrated warm white fibre optics and starburst-style lighting clusters illuminate the foliage with 13 selectable lighting settings. The lighting operates silently without moving mechanical parts. Attached branches and a metal stand provide structural support, while a 1.85m mains lead connects the lighting system to its power source. The foliage has certified fire-retardant properties, and the tree is suitable for indoor use only. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

nbjst30q.variantName: Christow 5ft 150 LED Cherry Blossom Tree – Warm White
nbjst30q.sourceDescription: Create an enchanting Christmas centrepiece with this Light Up Cherry Blossom Tree from Christow. Perfect for brightening your home or garden, it measures 150cm (5ft) and is decorated with beautiful blossom flowers which are illuminated by warm white LEDs. • LED Blossom Flowers: The warm white LEDs are encased by blossom flowers which refract the light to produce an enchanting festive glow. • Flexible Branches: Each branch has twigs sprouting from it to replicate the look of a natural blossom tree. • 5m Power Cable: Powered by a UK BS IP44 plug with a 5-metre cable to easily plug inside when displaying outside. • Ground Stakes: Supplied with a foldable metal stand which is coloured black to match the colour of the trunk and branches. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H150cm x W82cm x D82cm • Colour: Warm White • Material: PVC • Lights: Pre-lit • Tree shape: Small • Weight: 0.54kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL
